info.title: Unikraft Cloud Control Plane API
info.description: This specification describes the Unikraft Cloud Control Plane API, which provides mechanisms to interact with globally provided Unikraft Cloud system.

servers.description: Official Unikraft Cloud Control Plane API

post.description:
Signin initiates the sign-in process and returns an authorization URL.
 The user should be redirected to this URL to complete the sign-in.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description:
The hostname is the name of the machine making the request.  This is
 mandatory as it consitutes a unique identifier for the machine.

parameters.name: os
parameters.description: The operating system of the machine making the request.

parameters.name: os_version
parameters.description:
The version of the operating system of the machine making the request, if
 available.

 For Android, it's like "10", "11", "12", etc.  For iOS and macOS it's like
 "15.6.1" or "12.4.0".  For Windows it's like "10.0.19044.1889". For FreeBSD
 it's like "12.3-STABLE".  For Linux, this is simply the kernel version on
 Linux, like "5.10.0-17-amd64".

parameters.name: container
parameters.description: A best-effort whether the client is running in a container.

parameters.name: distro
parameters.description: The OS distribution, if known.  E.g. "debian", "ubuntu", "nixos", ...

parameters.name: distro_version
parameters.description: The OS distribution version if known.  E.g. "20.04", ...

parameters.name: distro_codename
parameters.description: THe OS distribution codename if known.  E.g. "jammy", "bullseye", ...

parameters.name: cli_version
parameters.description:
The CLI version is the version of the Unikraft CLI that is making the
 request.

parameters.name: goarch
parameters.description: If available, the GOARCH value (of the built binary).

parameters.name: goos
parameters.description: If available, the GOOS value (of the built binary)

parameters.name: go_version
parameters.description: if available, the Go version binary was built with.

@type.description: The type of the serialized message.

GoogleProtobufAny.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message.

message.description: An optional message providing additional information about the response.

data.description: The response data for this request.

op_time_us.description:
The operation time in microseconds.  This is the time it took to process
 the request and generate the response.

SigninResponse.description: The response message for a sign-in request.

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the [google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details.  There is a common set of message types for APIs to use.

Status.description: The `Status` type defines a logical error model that is suitable for different programming environments, including REST APIs and RPC APIs. It is used by [gRPC](https://github.com/grpc). Each `Status` message contains three pieces of data: error code, error message, and error details. You can find out more about this error model and how to work with it in the [API Design Guide](https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors).
